Hello HeliumDeploy Support,

I’m following up on order Shop····, placed October 8, which includes the
NEXUS QX1 (8 TH/s) and Harlo OS Diagnostics.

The order was supposed to ship on October 15, but your support chat
indicates it is still awaiting shipment.

Please explain the delay and confirm an updated shipping date. If the order
has already shipped, please provide the carrier and tracking number.

Thank you,
Robert H.
Note to the team: I'll pull the order up before I answer.

Hi Robert,

Thanks for following up, and I'm sorry you've had to ask again.

Your order Shop···· is paid and nothing has shipped yet, so there is no carrier or tracking to give you. Both lines, the NEXUS QX1 (8 TH/s) and the Harlo OS Diagnostics, are still to go out.

The reason for the delay is that the QX1 ships to you direct from the manufacturer rather than from our own warehouse, and they have not come back to us with a new date since the October 15 one on your order passed. I won't invent one, so I've put this in front of the team with your order number and asked them to get a firm date out of the manufacturer. They're offline this evening and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to this email address, so there's nothing you need to do.

Your $25 code HD-•••••• is still on file for the wait, usable on an order of $100 or more.

Sorry again for the run-around on this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
